SELECT "transactionrecord"."trdref" AS e, AVG((CAST(("transactionrecord"."cancelpct" - "transactionrecord"."offmkt") AS REAL) / "transactionrecord"."offmkt")) AS m1 FROM "transactionrecord" GROUP BY "transactionrecord"."trdref" ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT "compliancecase"."casestat" AS g, AVG("compliancecase"."fposrate") AS m1 FROM "compliancecase"  GROUP BY "compliancecase"."casestat"

WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "transactionrecord"."ordertypedist" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "advancedbehavior" JOIN "transactionrecord" ON "transactionrecord"."transreg" = "advancedbehavior"."translink" GROUP BY "transactionrecord"."ordertypedist"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT AVG("s3"."m2") AS v FROM "s3") SELECT "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, ("s3"."m2" - "s4"."v") AS m3 FROM "s3" JOIN "s4" ON "s4"."v" IS NOT NULL
SELECT "compliancecase"."transref" AS e, AVG("compliancecase"."prevviol") AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "compliancecase" GROUP BY "compliancecase"."transref" ORDER BY m2 DESC LIMIT 10

WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "sentimentandfundamentals"."transref" AS e, AVG("sentimentandfundamentals"."instownpct") AS m1, AVG(("sentimentandfundamentals"."infoleaksc" - "sentimentandfundamentals"."socscore")) AS m2 FROM "sentimentandfundamentals" GROUP BY "sentimentandfundamentals"."transref") SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s1"."m2") AS m2 FROM "s1"
SELECT AVG("sentimentandfundamentals"."putcallrt") AS m1, AVG(("sentimentandfundamentals"."impvolrank" - "sentimentandfundamentals"."inholdpct")) AS m2 FROM "sentimentandfundamentals"
SELECT "transactionrecord"."ordertypedist" AS g, AVG("transactionrecord"."modfreq") AS m1 FROM "transactionrecord"  GROUP BY "transactionrecord"."ordertypedist"

WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "trader"."tradekind" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "advancedbehavior" JOIN "transactionrecord" ON "transactionrecord"."transreg" = "advancedbehavior"."translink" JOIN "trader" ON "trader"."tradereg" = "transactionrecord"."trdref" GROUP BY "trader"."tradekind") SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS m1 FROM "s1"
